# SKOOTA

> > SKOOTA is a Japanese indie game media platform covering independent game news, events, and developer interviews.

SKOOTA focuses on the Japanese indie game scene, providing coverage of major events like SHIBUYA GAMES WEEK, Taipei Game Show, and Steam Next Fest, along with developer spotlights and game exhibitions across Japan.

## Key Topics

- SKOOTA
- SKOOTAGAMES
- indie games
- Japanese gaming
- game journalism
- TIGS (Tokyo Indie Game Summit)
- Steam Next Fest
- SHIBUYA GAMES WEEK
- Taipei Game Show
- event coverage
- game exhibitions
- 大阪ゲームダンジョン (Osaka Game Dungeon)
- indie media
- game events
